g.text: ‘Percy Jackson’ Stars on Learning to Scream and Sob on Set of Season 3: ‘I Love Playing the Dark Type of Scenes’ ◆ Joshua Jackson Teases ‘Sex, Drugs and Rock ‘n’ Roll’ in New HBO Max Series ‘How to Survive Without Me’: ‘I’m Getting Too Old For This S—’ ◆ Producer Will Packer Stumps to Get Out the Vote and Launch a Private HBCU Fundraising Campaign ◆ ‘It: Welcome to Derry’ Surprise Halloween Episode Drops on HBO Max ◆ Sourav Ganguly’s ‘Bigg Boss Bangla’ Among Highlights as Indian Media Giant JioStar Revenues Climb 10% ◆ Bill Maher Fact-Checks Kid Rock After He Compares Abdul El-Sayed to 9/11 Hijackers on ‘Real Time’ ◆
